# Fake SAM3 test model

`fake_sam3.onnx` is a tiny real ONNX graph (segments brighter-than-
mid-grey regions) generated by `scripts/make_fake_sam3_model.py`:

    uv run --with onnx python scripts/make_fake_sam3_model.py

It is executed in tests by the same ONNX Runtime session code as
the production SAM 3.1 model (`surmap.survey.sam3.OnnxSam3Session`)
— CPU provider in tests, CUDA provider on the station GPU. Only the
weights and the provider differ; there is no separate test path.
